# pf_anchor (Resource)

A pf anchor `api/<name>` owned by pfapid. The rules replace the anchor's ruleset as a whole.

Every change is applied with commit-confirm: pfapid loads it, the provider confirms it over the same connection, and pfapid rolls it back by itself if that confirmation never arrives. `terraform plan` runs the rules through `pfctl -n` on the firewall and shows the result in `pf_rules`.

If the rules loaded in pf differ from the committed ones (someone ran pfctl by hand), refresh warns and the next apply loads the configured rules again.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Kubernetes API and ingress for the prod cluster, plus egress NAT for its
# IPv4 node network. Loaded as anchor api/k8s-prod.
resource "pf_anchor" "k8s_prod" {
  name = "k8s-prod"
  rules = [
    {
      action    = "pass"
      direction = "in"
      quick     = true
      interface = "frontend"
      family    = "inet"
      protocol  = "tcp"
      to        = { table = "k8s_nodes", ports = [{ from = 443 }, { from = 6443 }] }
      label     = "k8s-prod-api"
    },
    {
      action    = "pass"
      direction = "in"
      quick     = true
      interface = "frontend"
      family    = "inet6"
      protocol  = "tcp"
      to        = { table = "k8s_nodes", ports = [{ from = 443 }] }
    },
    {
      action    = "match"
      direction = "out"
      interface = "frontend"
      family    = "inet"
      from      = { prefixes = ["10.70.1.0/24"] }
      nat       = { kind = "nat-to", interface = "frontend" }
    },
  ]
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Anchor name (`api/<name>` in pf). Lower case letters, digits, `-` and `_`, at most 31.
- `rules` (Attributes List) Rules in evaluation order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

### Read-Only

- `etag` (String) Version of the committed anchor; used to refuse changes made on a stale view.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `pf_rules` (List of String) The rules as pf loads them (`pfctl -nv` output, e.g. one line per port). Computed at plan time.

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Required:

- `action` (String) `pass`, `block` or `match` (`match` for NAT and prio without deciding).
- `family` (String) `inet` or `inet6`. Every rule names one family; use a table to cover both.
- `interface` (String) Interface or interface group from the firewall's pfapid policy (e.g. `frontend`). Never `mgmt`.

Optional:

- `block_return` (Boolean) `block` only: answer with TCP RST / ICMP unreachable instead of dropping. Defaults to `false`.
- `direction` (String) `in` or `out`. Omit for both directions.
- `from` (Attributes) Source. Omit for `any`. At most one of `prefixes`, `table` and `interface`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--from))
- `label` (String) pf label, shown in `pfctl -s labels` (letters, digits, space and `_.:/-`, at most 63).
- `log` (Boolean) Log matching packets to pflog. Defaults to `false`.
- `nat` (Attributes) Address translation. `pass` or `match` rules only. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--nat))
- `prio` (Attributes) Queue priority (`set prio`): `normal`, and optionally `low` for empty ACKs and low-delay packets. 0–7. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--prio))
- `protocol` (String) `tcp`, `udp`, `icmp` (inet) or `icmp6` (inet6). Omit for any protocol.
- `quick` (Boolean) Stop evaluating at this rule if it matches. Defaults to `false`.
- `to` (Attributes) Destination. Omit for `any`. At most one of `prefixes`, `table` and `interface`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--to))

<a id="nestedatt--rules--from"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules.from`

Optional:

- `interface` (String) The interface's own addresses, `(name)` in pf.
- `ports` (Attributes List) Ports (protocol `tcp` or `udp` only). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--from--ports))
- `prefixes` (List of String) Canonical CIDR prefixes, all of the rule's `family`.
- `table` (String) A managed table, `<table>` in pf.

<a id="nestedatt--rules--from--ports"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules.from.ports`

Required:

- `from` (Number) Port, or first port of a range.

Optional:

- `to` (Number) Last port of the range (inclusive). Omit for a single port.



<a id="nestedatt--rules--nat"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules.nat`

Required:

- `kind` (String) `nat-to`, `rdr-to`, `binat-to` or `af-to` (NAT64/NAT46, `pass in` only).

Optional:

- `address` (String) Translation address or prefix (`nat-to`, `rdr-to`, `binat-to`; same prefix length as the source for `binat-to`).
- `af_from` (String) `af-to` only: new source prefix.
- `af_to` (String) `af-to` only: new destination prefix.
- `interface` (String) `nat-to` only: translate to this interface's first address, `(iface:0)`, instead of `address`.
- `port` (Attributes) `rdr-to` only: destination port or range. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--nat--port))
- `to_family` (String) `af-to` only: the family to translate to.

<a id="nestedatt--rules--nat--port"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules.nat.port`

Required:

- `from` (Number) Port, or first port of a range.

Optional:

- `to` (Number) Last port of the range (inclusive). Omit for a single port.



<a id="nestedatt--rules--prio"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules.prio`

Required:

- `normal` (Number)

Optional:

- `low` (Number)


<a id="nestedatt--rules--to"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules.to`

Optional:

- `interface` (String) The interface's own addresses, `(name)` in pf.
- `ports` (Attributes List) Ports (protocol `tcp` or `udp` only). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--to--ports))
- `prefixes` (List of String) Canonical CIDR prefixes, all of the rule's `family`.
- `table` (String) A managed table, `<table>` in pf.

<a id="nestedatt--rules--to--ports"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules.to.ports`

Required:

- `from` (Number) Port, or first port of a range.

Optional:

- `to` (Number) Last port of the range (inclusive). Omit for a single port.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import pf_anchor.k8s_prod k8s-prod
```
